snippet.title: Principia Level Showcase - Maxi Dirtbike by MARRA92
snippet.description:
A flexible dirtbike that is very easily able to traverse steep terrain... Just watch out so you don't flip it over!

Level: https://principia-web.se/archive/level/21555

Principia is a free and open source physics-based sandbox game featuring mechanics, electronics, robots, puzzles, Lua scripting and more. You can read more about the game and download it for the supported platforms at: https://principia-web.se/
